campaigns.topic: 9 Small Business Loan Red Flags to Review Before Signing

serp_observations.intent: Informational pre-signing risk checklist for small business borrowers evaluating loan agreements, merchant cash advances, short-term financing and lender/broker pressure tactics.
page_types: Lender and marketplace blog posts about business loan agreement terms
Contract explainer articles covering personal guarantees, collateral, prepayment and default clauses
FTC and SBA predatory-lending and scam warnings
serp_observations.content_decision: Publish a focused pre-signing checklist, not another broad business-loan comparison or general loan-terms glossary, to avoid cannibalizing existing business-loan and loan-terms articles.

sources.used_for: SBA small business loan program context and predatory-lending warning signs
FTC small business financing enforcement context: hidden fees, daily debits and personal guarantee claims
Florida financial services license verification context
Required subreddit destination, described only as a peer-discussion community
